bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health care facilities; providing an exemption from assisted living facility design requirements for certain facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. EXEMPTION FROM ASSISTED LIVING FACILITY DESIGN REQUIREMENTS; CITY OF BELVIEW.

Subdivision 1.

Direction to commissioner of health.

The commissioner of health must approve a provisional license application submitted by an actively licensed nursing home applying for licensure as an assisted living facility if the nursing home is owned by a municipality and located in the city of Belview. Applications must be submitted on or before December 31, 2026.

Subd. 2.

Exemption from design requirements.

An actively licensed nursing home as described in subdivision 1 is exempt from design requirements under Minnesota Statutes, section 144G.45, subdivision 4. This exemption does not apply to new construction, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 144G.08, subdivision 42.
additions: EXEMPTION FROM ASSISTED LIVING FACILITY DESIGN REQUIREMENTS; CITY OF BELVIEW.

The commissioner of health must approve a provisional license application submitted by an actively licensed nursing home applying for licensure as an assisted living facility if the nursing home is owned by a municipality and located in the city of Belview. Applications must be submitted on or before December 31, 2026.

An actively licensed nursing home as described in subdivision 1 is exempt from design requirements under Minnesota Statutes, section 144G.45, subdivision 4. This exemption does not apply to new construction, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 144G.08, subdivision 42.
